items.why: Stocks are falling broadly, with the S&P 500 down 2% per AP, and fear is spiking as the selloff picks up.
AMD is sliding with other AI stocks that are dragging the US market lower, per AP.
Nvidia drama continues to unfold, per WSJ, with reports that Jensen Huang is weighing a CEO comeback and calls growing for his reinstatement.
Stocks are falling before Nvidia earnings, per Bloomberg, and GOOGL is sliding with the broader AI and tech selloff.

market_note: AI names are leading the slide ahead of Nvidia earnings.
summary: Stocks are sharply lower Monday afternoon. S&P futures are down 2.03% and Nasdaq futures are down 2.72%, with the VIX up 23.41% as the selloff picks up.
